candidates.summary: Beta checks: baseline/regression of shared services, local relay hardening, and public Access negatives.
Create or remove the owner-only Cloudflare Access app for link.knowslog.com; never prints the email or token.
Relay serves local synthetic relay.v1 transport and owner human-gate UI.
Synthetic QA seed and end-to-end adapter check; credentials stay in ignored local files only.
Verify synthetic MVP in a private Compose project without touching existing services or Tunnel.
Owner-only synthetic beta lifecycle for the separate "knowslink" Compose project; never touches other projects.
One synthetic pull adapter verifies signatures, persists a shared inbox, ACKs, then claims before judgment.
Postgres shared state serializes authorization, inbox, idempotency, and claims across relay processes.
Validate isolated example Compose settings and locked service boundaries.
Package config validates development settings without exposing secret values.
Prove product lint detects violations in temporary copies and propagates failure.
